# GRU: single test evaluation (generated by `scripts/run_neural_families.py --model gru`; part P3 of the completion batch)

Git commit `112bccd905`. LSTM L4 inputs, target and training procedure with the gru encoder; 12 random trials per task (stage-3 space, at most 10 epochs, patience 3), selection on validation, 3 seeds with early stopping on validation. MAE in MW. Models fitted on the training period only with the validation-chosen configuration and epochs.

| task | test MAE (MW) | selected hidden / lr / dropout / weight decay | best epochs (3 seeds) |
|---|---:|---|---|

| 24 h | 3,742 | 32 / 0.0007933 / 0.38 / 0.0022 | [5, 9, 7] |
| dayahead | 4,585 | 48 / 0.005021 / 0.13 / 0.0021 | [4, 11, 9] |
